mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, v.`status`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1

SELECT v.id, v.shop_id, v.title, v.sub_title, v.rules, v.pay_value, v.actual_value, v.type, v.status, sv.stock, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time, s.name AS shop_name, s.images AS shop_images FROM tb_voucher v INNER JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON sv.voucher_id = v.id WHERE v.status = 1 ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
